data.title: Pattaya teen footballer's death case still waits for arrest
data.description: The mother of a 15-year-old Thai-Swedish footballer who died after a road accident in Pattaya has appealed to senior police in Chonburi, saying an arrest warrant issued for the driver involved has yet to be executed despite seven months having passed since the crash.

data.title: Stray dog goes viral for chilling with tourist on the beach
data.description: SURAT THANI - A stray dog went viral after joining a tourist who was chilling by a Koh Phangan beach in the water, creating a heartwarming moment. Other tourists joined in to share the same experience with their four legs friends.

data.title: Heavy rain warning across Thailand, with thunderstorms over 70% of Bangkok
data.description: The Meteorological Department has warned of heavy to very heavy rain in parts of the North, Northeast, East and South over the next 24 hours, with the risk of flash floods, run-off from higher ground and mudslides, particularly in low-lying areas and on slopes near waterways.

data.title: Illicit contact lenses, cosmetics worth B4.7m seized at warehouse
data.description: Police and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) officials have seized more than 132,000 unregistered contact lenses, cosmetics and vitamins worth 4.7 million baht from a warehouse in Samut Prakan allegedly operated by a Chinese national.

data.title: Electrical worker dies after falling into Sukhumvit drain
data.description: A 32-year-old electrical contractor worker has died after apparently slipping and falling into a drainage pipe beneath Punnawithi BTS skytrain station in Bangkok’s Phra Khanong district on Friday morning.

data.title: THAI launches Da Nang route
data.description: Thai Airways International (THAI) will expand its network with a new Bangkok-Da Nang service and more flights on routes across Southeast Asia, Europe and China.

data.title: Maritime talks start on 'positive' note: govt
data.description: The first meeting in a compulsory conciliation process between Thailand and Cambodia over their maritime dispute was positive overall, with the process expected to take 11-12 months, according to a senior Foreign Ministry official.

data.title: Queen Mother's cremation plans advance
data.description: The government is preparing for the royal cremation ceremony for Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother scheduled for mid-December.

data.title: Travel plan exposes 'double life'
data.description: A visa application to visit China has exposed the identity of a Chinese murder suspect who had lived and conducted business in Pattaya for decades.

data.title: Govt to draft data centre rules
data.description: The government plans to draft a law specifically regulating data centres, with rules covering their use of electricity and water, fuel storage, safety and environmental impacts, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Thursday.

data.title: PM issues deadline for exam inquiry
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Interior Ministry to conclude its investigation into alleged cheating in local government recruitment examinations by Sept 30.

data.title: Govt targets citizenship loopholes
data.description: The government has ordered a review of Thai nationality application procedures and citizenship granted over the past year as it prepares amendments to the 1965 Nationality Act aimed at closing legal loopholes.

data.title: PM distances govt  from Vorapak saga
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has distanced his government from allegations linking former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong to Southeast Asian scam networks, saying Mr Vorapak must clear his name himself.

data.title: Bangkok rail fares to be capped at B45 from Jan 1
data.description: Bangkok commuters are set to benefit from a common fare of no more than 45 baht per trip on all electric train lines from Jan 1, 2027, under a government measure aimed at easing the cost of living.

data.title: 27 held in Surat Thani for Thai ID card fraud
data.description: SURAT THANI - Authorities arrested 27 people including civil servants and Thai residents of this southern province for allegedly facilitating the issuance of Thai ID cards for migrant workers.

data.title: 26 held in Surat Thani for Thai ID card fraud
data.description: SURAT THANI - Authorities arrested 26 people including civil servants and Thai residents of this southern province for allegedly facilitating the issuance of Thai ID cards for migrant workers.

data.title: Covid-19 cases on the rise, health officials say
data.description: Covid-19 infections in Thailand are on an upward trend, with an average of 15,000 new cases reported each week over the past four weeks, according to the Department of Disease Control (DDC).

data.title: Trespassers trample fragile moss on Chiang Mai peak
data.description: Doi Inthanon National Park, home to Thailand’s highest mountain, has stressed the importance of following park rules after a group of visitors trespassed on a restricted area to take pictures, damaging the sphagnum moss that forms a delicate green carpets on the high-altitude mountain bog.

data.title: PM orders quick deportation of errant foreigners
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, in his capacity as the interior minister, has ordered provincial governors and district chiefs to act quickly to deport foreigners who commit offences and take advantage of Thais.

data.title: Love-struck woman learns ‘pilot’ boyfriend was AI creation
data.description: A 66-year-old woman from Lampang travelled to Chiang Mai in search of what she believed was true love with a pilot she had met online, only to discover he was an AI-generated character, police said on Thursday.

data.title: Bangkok oil leak confirmed from Bangchak pipeline
data.description: Oil-contaminated wastewater in Bangkok has been traced to a Bangchak Group fuel pipeline along Chuea Phloeng Road in Khlong Toey district, Thitipat Chotidechachainan, secretary to the energy minister, confirmed on Thursday.

data.title: Scammers ‘rented Bangkok mansion for B900,000 a month’
data.description: Immigration police have arrested a group of foreigners who rented a mansion in Bangkok for 900,000 baht a month to operate a call scam centre targeting Japanese victims.

data.title: 2,200 firms suspected of nominee land holding
data.description: Thai authorities have identified about 2,200 companies suspected of illegally holding land through foreign-majority ownership as part of a crackdown on nominee businesses.

data.title: 2,200 firms eyed over nominees
data.description: Authorities have identified about 2,200 companies suspected of illegally holding land through foreign-majority ownership as part of a crackdown on nominee businesses.

data.title: Forest land to be reclaimed
data.description: Chiang Mai: Authorities are preparing to reclaim more than 7,000 rai of forest land in Chai Prakan district after identifying eight cases of encroachment for commercial farming, with demolition of structures and restoration work scheduled to begin next month.

data.title: Chinese man on money-laundering rap
data.description: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has arrested a Chinese national in Chiang Mai for allegedly laundering money for a transnational scam network linked to at least 16 online fraud cases.

data.title: B350m on table to fight tilapia spread
data.description: The government has approved 350 million baht in remaining central funds to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, following concerns about the species spreading into freshwater sources in the Northeast.

data.title: Doi Inthanon eyes listing
data.description: Thailand is seeking Asean Heritage Park status for Chiang Mai's Doi Inthanon National Park, with an expert assessment beginning on Wednesday.

data.title: Court jails former MP over proxy vote
data.description: The Supreme Court has sentenced former Pheu Thai Party MP Saranwut Saranket to eight months in prison for allowing another MP to use his parliamentary ID card to vote on his behalf.

data.title: EC reports big jump in complaints
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) handled thousands of election complaints and cases in fiscal 2024 and 2025, while allocating 282 million baht in subsidies to political parties, its secretary-general Sawaeng Boonmee said on Wednesday.

data.title: Discord in the EC boils over
data.description: The Election Commission (EC)'s announcement was supposed to close a chapter: 77 people referred to the Supreme Court over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

data.title: New trench tests border ceasefire
data.description: Tensions along the Thai-Cambodian border have risen after Cambodian troops dug trenches and installed concertina wire near Hill 450 in Si Sa Ket, prompting close monitoring by Thai forces.

data.title: Isan forges Vietnam Studies link
data.description: Khon Kaen University (KKU) has opened its Vietnam Studies Centre in collaboration with the Consulate General of Vietnam in Khon Kaen to mark the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Thailand and Vietnam.

data.title: Undersea art museum to open
data.description: Phuket: Asia's first underwater art museum will open in this southern resort province, with the RAYA Underwater Art Museum expected to create a new diving attraction while helping reduce pressure on natural coral reefs.

data.title: Govt urged to finalise expo details
data.description: Nakhon Ratchasima: The provincial Chamber of Commerce has called on the government to finalise a clear timeline and master plan for the 2029 World Horticultural Expo, following the cabinet's decision to relocate the event from Khong district to Pak Chong district.

data.title: Iconic Mon Bridge rafts get facelift
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Authorities in Sangkhla Buri district are reorganising the floating rafts surrounding the Mon Bridge following a multi-agency agreement aimed at restoring views of the landmark and upgrading management of the popular tourist attraction.

data.title: NACC targets EC bigwigs for ignoring allegations
data.description: The opposition People's Party (PP) will lodge a complaint with the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) over a decision by election commissioners to dismiss key allegations of collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

data.title: Deed amendment brings end to Khon Kaen temple land dispute
data.description: KHON KAEN - Land officials in Khon Kaen have amended details on a title deed to recognise Wat Pa Adulyaram as the rightful holder, resolving a bitter dispute with the heirs of the man who donated the land more than three decades ago.
